description: Redirect an in-flight delegation by sessionId: message goes to agy as a new instruction for the running turn, and the delegate call returns the redirected turn's result. Status: steered (sent), not-ready (prompt not sent yet; retry), not-running (turn already ended — resume instead), not-found (id not in this process's session history).

sessionId.description: From delegate's "session ready: <id>" progress notification or its result. When delegate runs as an MCP task, its server-side task id works too.

name: steer
title: Steer Antigravity delegation
